history.event: Incorporated as 'HDFC Bank Limited' after HDFC Ltd received RBI in-principle approval to set up a private-sector bank
Received banking licence and commenced operations as a Scheduled Commercial Bank
Times Bank Limited merged into HDFC Bank (first friendly merger of two new private banks)
Centurion Bank of Punjab amalgamation approved by RBI, completing the acquisition
HDFC Limited merged into HDFC Bank (India's largest-ever M&A, transformational merger announced 4 Apr 2022)
